question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution empowers Parliament to make laws relating to the acquisition and termination of the Indian Citizenship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Article 11** of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to regulate the acquisition and termination of Indian citizenship through legislation.
 
• This article provides the Parliament with the authority to make laws concerning all aspects of citizenship, including the procedures for acquiring, renouncing, or terminating it.
 
• The Citizenship Act of 1955, enacted under Article 11, governs the provisions related to Indian citizenship and details various modes of acquiring and losing citizenship.
